build_SO2_Convolution: build an SO(2) convolution layer for all m orders with optional radial weights and extra m0 gating channels
build_SO2_m_Conv_Block: build an optimized SO(2) convolution block using block-diagonal GEMM for faster tensor core utilization on m greater than 0
build_SO2_Conv1_WithRadialBlock: build the first SO(2) convolution layer with block-diagonal GEMM and external radial weight modulation for edge features
build_SO2_Conv2_InternalBlock: build the second SO(2) convolution layer with block-diagonal GEMM and internal weights only for internal message passing
build_SO2_Linear: build an SO(2) linear transformation layer for all m orders with optional radial function modulation on edge embeddings
